basics.name: Lucy Moglia
basics.label: Research Engineer
basics.summary: Electrical engineer with robust experience in full-stack electronics development, product development, and technical research. Proven ability to manage complex projects from concept to completion. Highly self-motivated, versatile. Experienced in embedded development, PCB design, prototype development/evaluation, reverse engineering, and technical writing.

projects.name: Cultured Neurons / Microelectrode Arrays
projects.description: Developing techniques for Frontier Tower's neurotech floor to read and stimulate cultured neurons, including maskless MEA fabrication, biocompatible fluid exchange systems, and custom signal acquisition boards.

projects.name: Micromppt
projects.description: Low-cost 5W autonomous solar charger with embedded perturb-and-observe setpoint adjustment. Designed for Meshtastic and other low power embedded devices. Now sold and distributed by a number of Meshtastic community hardware developers.

projects.name: Femtofox
projects.description: Tiny, inexpensive Linux-based Meshtastic client. Configuration, power usage testing, RF transmit power characterization, and custom MPPT solar charger design.

projects.name: NonHumanScent, Artificial Olfaction
projects.description: Designed electronic olfaction gas composition sensors and developed open-source edge ML electronic olfaction dev kits with MOX sensor arrays and ESP32-S3.

projects.name: Gamma Spectroscopy
projects.description: Modeling and building scintillator + SiPM gamma spectroscopes for radioisotope identification. Custom signal conditioning and pulse height analysis.

projects.name: Spacebridge High Altitude Balloon PCB
projects.description: High altitude balloon payload PCB with LoRa, GPS, heating, environmental sensing, and a cutoff mechanism. Built with Noisebridge's Spacebridge group.

projects.name: DRSSTC Tesla Coil
projects.description: Dual resonant solid state Tesla coil. Gate driver, interrupter, and full-bridge inverter design and construction.

projects.name: Head In A Jar (OpenSauce 2025)
projects.description: Interactive animatronic robot head with silicone skin, fine-tuned LLM with knowledge graph integration, and custom voice model. Exhibited at OpenSauce 2025.

projects.name: 10kW Microwave Furnace
projects.description: 10kW 2.4GHz RF microwave furnace using repurposed magnetrons. High power waveguide design, interlock systems, and thermal management.

projects.name: Voron 2.4 Build
projects.description: 350mm self-sourced Voron V2.4r2 CoreXY 3D printer. Full mechanical and electrical assembly, Klipper firmware configuration.
